metadata.title: fix: Add server-scoped metrics to prevent cross-server aggregation (#3642)
metadata.author: rakdutta

description:
## Summary

  Fixes metrics aggregation bug where `/servers/{server_id}/tools?include_metrics=true` returned incorrect totals aggregated across ALL servers instead of server-specific metrics. This prevented accurate per-server SLA tracking and
  observability in multi-tenant deployments.

  ## Changes

  ### Database Schema
  - Added `server_id` column to 6 metrics tables: `tool_metrics`, `resource_metrics`, `prompt_metrics`, and their `*_hourly` rollup variants
  - Column is nullable to support legacy metrics and admin UI executions (no server context)
  - Added indexes for query performance
  - **Migration:** `cdcb8fb5d994_server_id_add_into_metrics_tables.py`

  ### Core Implementation
  - **ORM Models** (`db.py`): Updated all metrics models with `server_id` field
  - **Services**: Modified metrics recording to capture `server_id` context:
    - `tool_service.py`: Pass server_id during tool execution and metrics aggregation
    - `resource_service.py`: Pass server_id during resource access
    - `prompt_service.py`: Pass server_id during prompt execution
  - **Metrics Aggregation**: Updated `metrics_summary` properties to filter by `server_id`
  - **Rollup Service** (`metrics_rollup_service.py`): Updated hourly aggregation to group by `server_id`

  ### Prometheus Metrics
  - Added opt-in `PROMETHEUS_SERVER_SCOPED_METRICS` feature flag to control label cardinality
  - When enabled, Prometheus counters include `server_id` label dimension
  - Defaults to `false` to prevent cardinality explosion in large deployments
  - Updated circuit breaker plugin to support server-scoped labels

  ### Testing
  - Updated 21 test files to accommodate server_id parameter
  - All existing tests pass with backward compatibility for null server_id

  ### Documentation
  - Added comprehensive design document: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-03-20-server-scoped-metrics-design.md`

  ## Backward Compatibility

  ✅ **Fully backward compatible:**
  - Existing metrics retain `server_id = NULL`
  - Queries without server_id filter aggregate all metrics (preserves current behavior)
  - Queries with server_id filter return server-scoped metrics (fixes the bug)
  - Admin UI executions continue to work with null server_id

## Testing Checklist

  ### Database Metrics
  - [ ] Metrics recorded with correct `server_id` during tool/resource/prompt execution
  - [ ] `/servers/{server_id}/tools?include_metrics=true` returns server-scoped metrics
  - [ ] `/servers/{server_id}/resources?include_metrics=true` returns server-scoped metrics
  - [ ] `/servers/{server_id}/prompts?include_metrics=true` returns server-scoped metrics
  - [ ] Admin UI executions work with `server_id = NULL`
  - [ ] Hourly rollup aggregation includes `server_id` grouping
  - [ ] Alembic migration is idempotent and handles existing data

  ### Prometheus Metrics
  - [ ] Prometheus metrics work correctly with `PROMETHEUS_SERVER_SCOPED_METRICS=false` (default)
  - [ ] Prometheus counters include `server_id` label when `PROMETHEUS_SERVER_SCOPED_METRICS=true`
  - [ ] Prometheus metrics gracefully handle null `server_id` (admin UI executions)
  - [ ] Circuit breaker plugin metrics include `server_id` label when feature enabled
  - [ ] No cardinality explosion with multiple servers

  ### General
  - [ ] All unit tests pass
  - [ ] No regressions in existing metrics functionality

  ## Related Issues

  Closes #3642
